scenario_name: Beijing Changfeng Hospital urban fire rescue route planning with AMap data
description: Road geometry and traffic status come from AMap Web Service. Fire risk is generated by overlaying a Changfeng Hospital urban-fire response buffer with road polylines. Congestion is weighted more strongly than in earthquake and flood examples.
start_label: 起点：卢沟桥消防救援站
historical_event_name: 2023 Beijing Changfeng Hospital urban fire response zone
risk_design_note: For urban fire response, the destination is inside the incident area, so fire-affected road segments are penalized but remain passable to allow fire engines to reach the scene.
